products.name: Noor Kundan Jhumka Earrings
products.alt: Pair of gold-tone jhumka earrings with filigree domes (demo photo)
products.short: Bell-shaped gold-tone jhumkas set with white kundan stones and a fringe of faux pearls.
products.description:
Our Noor jhumkas pair a floral kundan stud with a domed bell finished in fine gold-tone plating and edged with faux pearls. Lightweight enough for a full evening, they suit mehndi, Eid and wedding looks.

Material: brass alloy with gold-tone plating, kundan glass stones, faux pearls.
Length: approx. 5.5 cm. Push-back closure.
Care: keep dry, avoid perfume, store in the Ayatcollections pouch.

products.name: Zara Textured Hoop Earrings
products.alt: Gold-tone ribbed hoop earrings on white (demo photo)
products.short: Bold ribbed gold-tone hoops for everyday shine.
products.description:
Zara drops are shaped like an opening bloom in a warm rose-gold tone, hung on slim hook fittings. Pretty with western and eastern outfits alike.

Material: alloy with rose-gold-tone plating.
Length: approx. 3 cm. Hook closure.
Care: wipe with a soft dry cloth after wearing.

products.name: Rania Pavé Heart Pendant
products.alt: Gold-tone heart pendant set with crystals on a fine chain (demo photo)
products.short: A crystal-studded heart pendant on a delicate chain.
products.description:
Rania layers rows of gold-tone beads and petals with coloured stone accents for a classic festive look. Wear it with a matching pair of jhumkas for mehndi or Eid.

Material: alloy with gold-tone plating, glass stones.
Fit: adjustable dori, 36–44 cm.
Care: store flat in its box; avoid water and perfume.

products.name: Mehr Crystal Bar Set
products.alt: Gold-tone necklace, earrings and ring set with crystal bars (demo photo)
products.short: Matching necklace, earrings and ring with sliding crystal bars.
products.description:
Mehr is a simple teardrop pendant in a polished gold tone on a fine cable chain — an easy everyday piece and a lovely gift.

Material: alloy with gold-tone plating.
Length: 45 cm with 5 cm extender. Lobster clasp.
Care: fasten the clasp before storing.

products.name: Laila Gold Bangle Set
products.alt: Four polished gold-tone bangles stacked together (demo photo)
products.short: Four polished gold-tone bangles, sold as a set. Choose your bangle size.
products.description:
The Laila set is four engraved karas with a soft, hand-polished shine. Wear all four together or split them across both wrists.

Material: alloy with gold-tone plating.
Sizes: 2.4 (small), 2.6 (medium), 2.8 (large) — the inner diameter in inches.
Care: remove before washing hands; store in the pouch.

products.name: Sana Crystal Cuff Bangle
products.alt: Gold-tone open cuff bangle set with clear crystals (demo photo)
products.short: An open gold-tone cuff lined with sparkling crystals.
products.description:
Sana is a slim open cuff with a row of clear crystals that catch the light. It slips on easily and pairs well with a watch or other bangles.

Material: alloy with gold-tone plating, cubic zirconia.
Fit: adjustable, fits most wrists.
Care: clean gently with a soft dry cloth.

products.name: Hira Crystal Bar Ring
products.alt: Gold-tone ring with a crystal bar on white (demo photo)
products.short: A slim gold-tone ring with a sparkling crystal bar. Choose your size.
products.description:
Hira sets a cushion-cut pink stone in a bright halo of small crystals on a rose-gold-tone band — a sweet statement ring for engagements and parties.

Material: alloy with rose-gold-tone plating, glass stone, cubic zirconia.
Sizes: 6, 7, 8 (US).
Care: remove before applying lotion or perfume.

products.name: Amal Chain Link Ring
products.alt: Gold-tone chain link ring with crystals on white (demo photo)
products.short: A modern chain-link ring with a crystal accent.
products.description:
Amal is a trio of slim stacking rings: a plain polished band, a pavé zircon band and a band set with a single purple stone. One size fits most (US 6–7).

Material: alloy with gold-tone plating, cubic zirconia, glass stone.
Care: store each ring separately to avoid scratches.

products.name: Mahi Gold-Tone Anklet
products.alt: Gold-tone stainless steel anklet with a fine curb chain (demo photo)
products.short: A fine curb-chain anklet that stays bright in water.
products.description:
Mahi is a slim gold-tone chain anklet with an extender, light enough to wear every day.

Material: 316L stainless steel with gold-tone PVD plating. Anti-tarnish, waterproof and safe for everyday wear.
Care: rinse, pat dry and store in the SHAYA pouch.

products.name: Aira Pave Hand Cuff
products.alt: Rose-gold-tone hand cuff with crystal panels on white (demo photo)
products.short: A statement hinged cuff with crystal panels.
products.description:
Aira is a hinged hand cuff with two crystal panels and a clean polished finish.

Material: 316L stainless steel with gold-tone PVD plating. Anti-tarnish, waterproof and safe for everyday wear.
Care: rinse, pat dry and store in the SHAYA pouch.

products.name: Sara Adjustable Knot Cuff
products.alt: Gold-tone adjustable knot cuff on a wrist (demo photo)
products.short: An open knot cuff that adjusts to fit.
products.description:
Sara is an open cuff with a love-knot front. Gently press to adjust the fit.

Material: 316L stainless steel with gold-tone PVD plating. Anti-tarnish, waterproof and safe for everyday wear.
Care: rinse, pat dry and store in the SHAYA pouch.

products.name: Mehak Twin Nose Ring
products.short: A pair of slim hoops for a delicate look.
products.description:
Mehak is a set of two seamless hoops in fine gold-tone steel.

Material: 316L stainless steel with gold-tone PVD plating. Anti-tarnish, waterproof and safe for everyday wear.
Care: rinse, pat dry and store in the SHAYA pouch.

products.name: Hana Permanent Chain Bracelet
products.alt: Dainty gold-tone chain bracelets with tiny charms on white (demo photo)
products.short: A dainty chain made to stay on, day and night.
products.description:
Hana is a fine satellite chain with tiny charms, made to be worn without taking off.

Material: 316L stainless steel with gold-tone PVD plating. Anti-tarnish, waterproof and safe for everyday wear.
Care: rinse, pat dry and store in the SHAYA pouch.

products.name: Zoya Charm Bracelet
products.alt: Gold-tone charm bracelet with pearls and shell charms (demo photo)
products.short: A chunky link bracelet with pearl and shell charms.
products.description:
Zoya is a chunky link bracelet carrying pearls, shells and sea charms.

Material: 316L stainless steel with gold-tone PVD plating. Anti-tarnish, waterproof and safe for everyday wear.
Care: rinse, pat dry and store in the SHAYA pouch.

products.name: Noori Layered Anja Hand Chain
products.alt: Layered gold-tone hand chain (anja) linking a finger ring to the wrist (demo photo)
products.short: A layered hand chain from ring to wrist with tiny charms.
products.description:
Noori is a layered anja (hand chain) that links a finger ring to a wrist chain, finished with tiny moon and star charms.

Material: 316L stainless steel with gold-tone PVD plating. Anti-tarnish, waterproof and safe for everyday wear.
Care: rinse, pat dry and store in the SHAYA pouch.
